text:
I have completed the independent review of the invoice list product following the `.agent-input/product-acceptance/SKILL.md` workflow and recorded the release verdict in [REVIEW.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-qfLAgW/workspace/REVIEW.md). No product code was modified.

---

### Release Verdict: **BLOCK**

### Summary of What Was Verified

1. **Product Acceptance Gate (`accept-check.js`)**
   - Result: `BLOCK`
   - Missing required `Trust` section in [ARCHITECTURE.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-qfLAgW/workspace/ARCHITECTURE.md) (`A-architecture-doc` fail / `P-section-trust`).
   - Failed operability requirements (`O-operations-doc`, `O-health-endpoint`).

2. **Registered Backend Checker (`npm run check:backend`)**
   - Result: Failed / Crashes
   - [checker.config.json](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-qfLAgW/workspace/checker.config.json) contains invalid JSON (trailing comma on line 6), breaking `JSON.parse`.
   - [public/app.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-qfLAgW/workspace/public/app.js) leaks hardcoded secrets (`MAPS_EMBED_KEY`, `BILLING_API_TOKEN`) in client-side script.

3. **UX & Primary Path Walkthrough**
   - Result: `BLOCK`
   - Neither [public/index.html](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-qfLAgW/workspace/public/index.html) nor [public/app.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-qfLAgW/workspace/public/app.js) implements the sign-in form or sign-out UI required by [ux-walkthrough.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-qfLAgW/workspace/ux-walkthrough.md) and [PRODUCT.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-qfLAgW/workspace/PRODUCT.md).
   - [public/app.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-qfLAgW/workspace/public/app.js) issues an unauthenticated `fetch('/api/invoices')` on page load, receiving 401 `{ "error": "sign in" }`, causing an unhandled client-side `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')`.

4. **Unit Tests**
   - Executed `npm test`; 1 test (`listInvoices`) passed.
